description: Deliver an audience as a download using available organization subscription capacity. Required capacity depends on the selected records, attributes, and existing licenses. Supply template_id OR field_list — not both. Review the subscription capacity estimate from quote_delivery with the user before starting delivery. Returns delivery progress and signed download links once completed. Completion or failure may notify configured external webhooks and opted-in users by email; completion may also email the delivery creator and configured organization contacts. Requires 'creator' scope.

field_list.description: Custom list of field names (alternative to template_id)

include_unmatched.description: (matched subtype) Include rows that did not resolve to a real graph match — these get a best-effort derived iag_person_id (or null), not a real match. Defaults to true.

output_compression.description: Explicit download compression. gzip supports csv/json/jsonl; Avro uses native DEFLATE and rejects outer gzip. Never inherited from input compression.

output_format.description: Output file format for download deliveries. Omit to auto-detect: matched audiences default to their uploaded file format; all others default to csv.

name: deliver_audience

count_state.description: Unknown means no count; available does not guarantee freshness. Recount for a current value.

download_urls.description: Fresh signed artifact URLs on an individual completed download delivery

guidance.description: Interpretation or recovery guidance for this result

next_actions.description: Suggested next calls using returned IDs and available scopes. Not executed and not user consent.

page_count.description: Number of objects on this page, not the organization total

population_input.description: Population input used for the preview; IDs refer to their current saved definitions

title: Deliver Audience
